# H ask not describe

> Escalate the thing you want done, not the thing that is wrong.


## The heuristic

**Escalate the thing you want done, not the thing that is wrong.**


_Why:_ Receivers act on requests and merely read descriptions. An escalation ending in a description gets acknowledged and set down; one ending in a specific ask gets a yes, a no, or a counter-proposal — all three of which are progress.
